Want to experience the nano-texture of an iPad screen, but not ready for a long-term commitment? Astropad has launched a brand new version of Rock Paper Pencil, retaining the detachable design while adding a second writing feel.

Apple Pencil paired with iPad now offers the feel of a pencil—the all-new Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 officially arrives

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 combines a nano-texture screen protector with a specially designed Apple Pencil nib. For the first time, buyers can choose between two options: the smooth feel of a ballpoint pen, or the soft, high-friction drag of graphite.

The all-new graphite nib mimics the feel of a 2B pencil, adding extra friction to meet artists' needs for sketching, shading, and expressing strokes.

Astropad says developing this new option took about a year, with a standard 2B pencil used as the reference benchmark. The company also says the finished product recreates the visual and sound effects of real graphite.

Ballpoint pen or standard pencil feel—your choice

The original steel ballpoint nib is retained, suitable for writing, line outlining, fine-line drawing, and neat note-taking. Each Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 set now comes with four Apple Pencil nibs: two ballpoint nibs and two graphite nibs.

The screen protector itself remains unchanged. Astropad's patented NanoCling system uses static adhesion rather than adhesive, so it can be applied, removed, and reused at any time without leaving any residue.

The company says this adhesion is stronger than magnets while supporting bubble-free application and easy removal. The protector's micro-texture mimics the feel of fine-grained paper, providing friction and better control.

The best matte screen protector for iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is more than just changing an Apple Pencil nib or altering the screen texture—it treats both as an integrated system. Astropad says the special nibs are designed specifically for the nano-texture protector. The all-new graphite nib is made of POM, while the ballpoint nib is steel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is now on sale for US$49.99, with free shipping worldwide. Version 3.0 is also on sale simultaneously, while stocks last, with discount offers available.
